description: SessionStart hook to inject file-read MCP tool directives.

hooks.command: bash -lc 'root="${CODEX_PLUGIN_ROOT:-}"; if [ -z "${root}" ] && [ -x ./hooks/scripts/session-start.sh ]; then root=.; fi; if [ -z "${root}" ] && [ -x ./plugins/file-read/hooks/scripts/session-start.sh ]; then root=./plugins/file-read; fi; if [ -n "${root}" ]; then exec bash "${root}/hooks/scripts/session-start.sh"; fi; exit 0'
